enchantments.tooltip: +12 Enhancement Bonus: +12 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Solar VI: On Hit: 6 to 24 Light Damage.
Vertigo +15: This effect gives a +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip and Improved Trip attempts.
Metalline: Metalline bypasses any metal based damage reduction. (Adamantine, "Alchemical, Silver", Byeshk, Cold Iron, Mithral)

Improved Banishing: On Hit: 4 to 24 Bane damage to Outsiders.On Vorpal Hit: If an outsider struck by this weapon has fewer than 1500 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the outsider has above 1500 Hit Points, it takes 150 damage.
Holy VI: On Hit: 6 to 24 Good damage. Good-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Evil user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
Flametouched Iron: Flametouched Iron grants +1 saves versus Evil Outsiders.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
